---
title: "Code"
---

For each guided lab workflow, begin with the **starter**. It contains the given
setup and task prompts, but not the completed commands. After making a serious
attempt, compare your work with the **possible solution**. A solution is one
valid approach, not the only acceptable program.

## Setup Checks

- [MATLAB and Symbolic Math Toolbox check](setup/check_matlab_setup.m)
- [R, required packages, and Quarto check](setup/check-r-setup.R)

Run these on the computer you intend to use. The
[software requirements page](../resources/software-requirements.qmd) explains
the expected results and deadlines.

## Policy

Do not copy a possible solution before attempting the starter. Submitted
student work must include interpretation, validation, and appropriate
attribution of AI assistance.
